name: Lunar Lander

meta.name: Lunar Lander
meta.tagline: Brake, align, and touch down gently on the lunar pad.
meta.description: Guide a small lander toward the marked pad using its main engine and side jets. The moon's gravity pulls the craft down, and a landing only counts if the lander reaches the pad slowly with little horizontal drift.

rewardTerms.description: Accumulated shaping reward for lining up with the pad and descending.
One-time reward for a safe touchdown on the pad.
Fraction of the starting fuel spent.
Number of hard landings or boundary crashes.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Balance alignment, safe landing, and fuel use.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Favor careful alignment and conserving fuel.

human.hint: Use Up for the main engine and Left/Right for the side jets.
